axioms.statement: The LLM never gets a vote on the conclusion.
axioms.rationale: Demotes the model to intake-clerk + lab; the verdict is the deterministic DAG's, never the model's.
axioms.name: The LLM never gets a vote on the conclusion.

axioms.rationale: No field a curator (human or LLM) can set to make the diagnosis come out right.
axioms.name: IsClinicallyActionable is computed, never entered.

axioms.statement: The trust boundary is a line in the DAG: fields with a formula are the model's; raw-input leaf fields are the LLM's (or a human's).
axioms.rationale: Makes the boundary mechanically checkable rather than a vibe.
axioms.name: The trust boundary is a line in the DAG: fields with a formula are the model's; raw-input leaf fields are the LLM's (or a human's).

axioms.statement: The LLM does exactly two things, both at the leaf layer: interpret intake facts, and produce synthetic-but-transparent test results.
axioms.rationale: Intake clerk + lab — the un-alarming medical roles. It computes no higher-order inference.
axioms.name: The LLM does exactly two things, both at the leaf layer: interpret intake facts, and produce synthetic-but-transparent test results.

axioms.statement: Every choice the LLM makes is a literal, editable knob in the admin UI.
axioms.rationale: The model's judgment is fully externalized; a wrong input is nudged, not re-prompted.
axioms.name: Every choice the LLM makes is a literal, editable knob in the admin UI.

axioms.statement: Every DAG formula is inspectable and correctable in place, like a spreadsheet cell.
axioms.rationale: Editing a value or formula body is local to its dependency subtree; only retyping/regraphing ripples.
axioms.name: Every DAG formula is inspectable and correctable in place, like a spreadsheet cell.

axioms.statement: Extraction and derivation are verifiable independently (three-panel witness).
axioms.rationale: Input case text -> extracted facts w/ provenance -> deterministic diagnosis. Defeats the laundering objection.
axioms.name: Extraction and derivation are verifiable independently (three-panel witness).

axioms.statement: The same deterministic machine must land on either side and name the single deciding gate.
axioms.rationale: An engine that only ever says "actionable" proves nothing.
axioms.name: The same deterministic machine must land on either side and name the single deciding gate.

axioms.statement: The diagnosis report is derived, never authored as prose; it is structured natural language assembled from the DAG.
axioms.rationale: A prose writeup would be a second, unwitnessed surface where a hallucination could hide. The report must be a deterministic projection of facts already in the graph, the same way Postgres views are.
axioms.name: The diagnosis report is derived, never authored as prose; it is structured natural language assembled from the DAG.

axioms.statement: Every word the patient gave us, and every node linked to that patient in the DAG down to ground truth, is represented somewhere in that patient's report.
axioms.rationale: Completeness is the whole point: nothing the patient said and no derived fact may silently vanish from the writeup. If a value mattered enough to enter the DAG, it earns a sentence (or a deliberate, predicate-suppressed absence).
axioms.name: Every word the patient gave us, and every node linked to that patient in the DAG down to ground truth, is represented somewhere in that patient's report.

axioms.statement: No single piece of report language is more complex than one spreadsheet cell: it references sibling values directly and does no joins or group-bys.
axioms.rationale: CMCC/SDLAF discipline. A narrative fragment is a calculated field on a row; it reads other fields of that same row (and global phrases from __meta), never traverses or aggregates. Complex sentences are decomposed into constituent fragment fields, each one cell-simple.
axioms.name: No single piece of report language is more complex than one spreadsheet cell: it references sibling values directly and does no joins or group-bys.

axioms.statement: A fragment's language only appears when its predicates hold for that row; irrelevant language is suppressed per case.
axioms.rationale: Case-by-case, not a globally imposed template. The same field yields "normal temperature", "light fever", or "severe fever" depending on the row's own value; a fragment whose predicate is false renders empty and contributes nothing to that patient's report.
axioms.name: A fragment's language only appears when its predicates hold for that row; irrelevant language is suppressed per case.

axioms.statement: Complex language is built from intermediate translation fields: calculated text fragments composed from other predicates on the same row, then composed upward.
axioms.rationale: The way to keep every piece cell-simple is to pull a complex sentence apart into its constituent fragments, each its own field, and let higher fragments reference lower ones. The report is the top of that composition, not a monolith.
axioms.name: Complex language is built from intermediate translation fields: calculated text fragments composed from other predicates on the same row, then composed upward.

axioms.statement: Common, reusable language lives once in the __meta settings table and is referenced by fragments; it is not re-implemented per case.
axioms.rationale: Literal global phrases ("The patient presented with…") and shared banding vocabulary belong in __meta so they are authored and corrected in one place. Fragments reference them; the per-row logic stays contextual while the wording stays DRY.
axioms.name: Common, reusable language lives once in the __meta settings table and is referenced by fragments; it is not re-implemented per case.

axioms.statement: The schema may be expressed in RuleSpeak-style language, but the diagnosis report itself is derived (rendered), not declared.
axioms.rationale: RuleSpeak documents the rules; it is not the patient-facing artifact. The report is a rendered projection of each patient's row values through the fragment fields — generated by a thin renderer that only concatenates already-derived, predicate-gated fragments in order.
axioms.name: The schema may be expressed in RuleSpeak-style language, but the diagnosis report itself is derived (rendered), not declared.

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Renal involvement of SLE; immune-complex glomerulonephritis. v2 models its PROGRESSION as a witnessed state machine driven by rising anti-dsDNA + falling complement + proteinuria.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Lupus Nephritis

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Which therapy to choose given the patient's causal mechanism + disease state: mycophenolate (MMF) vs belimumab vs anifrolumab. v2 derives a recommended line + single deciding reason.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Treatment-Line Selection

disease_domain_concepts.definition: CNS/PNS manifestations of SLE (seizure, psychosis, cognitive). Modeled as a phenotype subtype carrying a SeverityScore and organ-domain tag.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Neuropsychiatric Lupus (NPSLE)

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Skin-limited or skin-predominant lupus (acute/subacute/chronic discoid). Phenotype subtype with organ-domain = skin.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Cutaneous Lupus

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Irreversible accumulated damage, SLICC-style. Modeled as a monotonic damage-accrual score distinct from reversible disease activity.
disease_domain_concepts.challenge_stressor_type: disease progression / feedback between progression and molecular state
disease_domain_concepts.name: Organ Damage (SLICC/ACR Damage Index)

disease_domain_concepts.definition: RF/anti-CCP-positive RA; stronger HLA shared-epitope + PTPN22 association, more erosive. Phenotype subtype with a serostatus tag.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Seropositive RA (ACPA/RF+)

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Autoantibody-negative RA; distinct genetic architecture and trajectory. Phenotype subtype.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Seronegative RA (ACPA/RF-)

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Radiographic bone erosion; a structural-damage progression axis for RA, distinct from disease activity.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Erosive Disease

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Spinal/sacroiliac involvement of PsA. Phenotype subtype with axial domain tag.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Axial Psoriatic Arthritis

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Inflammation at tendon/ligament insertions; hallmark of PsA/SpA. Phenotype subtype.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Enthesitis

disease_domain_concepts.definition: 'Sausage digit' — whole-digit swelling. PsA phenotype subtype.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Dactylitis

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Inflammatory eye disease overlapping spondyloarthritis. Phenotype subtype / extra-articular domain.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Uveitis

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Gut inflammation overlapping spondyloarthritis (IL-23/IL-17 axis shared). Phenotype subtype representing cross-disease pleiotropy.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Inflammatory Bowel Disease Overlap

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Episodic relapse of disease activity. v2 models flare-risk as a derived state on the progression machine, driven by serology trajectory.
disease_domain_concepts.challenge_stressor_type: feedback between disease progression and molecular state
disease_domain_concepts.name: Flare Pattern

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Composite activity indices (SLEDAI-2K for SLE, DAS28 for RA). v2 DERIVES an activity tier from raw component observations rather than hand-entering it.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Disease-Activity Score (SLEDAI / DAS28)

disease_domain_concepts.definition: First-line / second-line / advanced-therapy sequencing. Modeled as an ordinal on therapies feeding treatment-line selection.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Treatment Line

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Monitoring for therapy harms. Present as a concept/stressor type; the keystone already carries HasAdverseEffect at the leaf. Deep AE modeling is out-of-scope for the POC.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Adverse-Event Surveillance

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Entry into specialist care. Represented as the initial state of the clinical-workflow machine.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Workflow: Referral

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Weighing competing diagnoses. Workflow state.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Workflow: Differential Diagnosis

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Ordering the labs/imaging that BECOME the raw leaves. Workflow state.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Workflow: Workup

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Applying classification criteria (e.g. EULAR/ACR). Workflow state.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Workflow: Classification

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Establishing baseline activity/damage. Workflow state; consumes the derived activity score.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Workflow: Baseline Severity Assessment

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Selecting therapy; consumes the treatment-line-selection DAG. Workflow state.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Workflow: Treatment Choice

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Longitudinal follow-up; produces the serology trajectory leaves. Workflow state.
disease_domain_concepts.name: Workflow: Monitoring

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Responding to a flare. Workflow state tied to the flare-risk progression state.

disease_domain_concepts.definition: Damage accrual, remission, outcomes over time. Workflow terminal state.

glossary_terms.definition: A literal, editable leaf value in the admin UI representing one choice the LLM (or a human) made; nudged, not re-prompted, when wrong.
glossary_terms.name: knob

glossary_terms.definition: The only two roles the LLM plays: interpret intake facts (clerk) and produce the case's test results (lab). Never the diagnostician.
glossary_terms.name: intake clerk + lab

glossary_terms.definition: The trust boundary, stated mechanically: fields with a formula belong to the model; raw-input leaf fields are the LLM's or a human's.
glossary_terms.name: line in the DAG

glossary_terms.definition: Input case text | extracted facts with per-fact provenance | deterministic diagnosis + gate trace — the two halves checkable independently.
glossary_terms.name: three-panel witness

glossary_terms.definition: Test results are synthetic (the case is invented) but every number is visible, sourced to the case, and editable; nothing is hidden.
glossary_terms.name: fake-but-transparent

glossary_terms.definition: The skeptic's claim that a deterministic function over LLM-chosen inputs just launders a hallucination; defeated by externalized knobs + independent witness.
glossary_terms.name: laundering objection

glossary_terms.definition: The v2 layer the audit asked for: disease modeled as a WITNESSED state machine whose transitions fire only on raw longitudinal observations (rising anti-dsDNA, falling C3/C4, proteinuria). Current state and dwell-time are derived & bitemporal — the contrast the audit drew with an 'evidence gate'.
glossary_terms.name: disease state simulator

glossary_terms.definition: The v1 layer: per-patient adjudication of whether a prediction is trustworthy enough to act on (the four gates + IsClinicallyActionable). v2 keeps this and adds the disease-state simulator above it on the same hub.
glossary_terms.name: evidence gate

glossary_terms.definition: A state machine on the polymorphic StateMachines substrate whose subject is a patient's disease course (presymptomatic -> serologic-active -> early-nephritis -> renal-flare-risk -> biopsy-indicated). Transitions are raw-leaf-triggered; current state is the derived IsCurrent occupancy.
glossary_terms.name: disease progression machine

glossary_terms.definition: Bitemporal derivation: how long a subject has been in a disease state (now - EnteredAt while current; ExitedAt - EnteredAt once left). The audit asked for 'how long has the patient/disease been in a state' — this is that, as a formula.
glossary_terms.name: dwell time

glossary_terms.definition: The raw longitudinal leaves driving progression: anti-dsDNA titre trend (rising/stable/falling), complement C3/C4 trend, proteinuria. The LLM/lab may emit these; everything above them is derived.
glossary_terms.name: serology trajectory

glossary_terms.definition: Derived field: given the patient's confirmed causal mechanism + current disease state, the recommended therapy (MMF vs belimumab vs anifrolumab) and the single deciding reason. The audit's second worked example.
glossary_terms.name: treatment line recommendation

glossary_terms.definition: The cohort-level surface where causal-hypothesis patterns EMERGE across many patients (vs v1's per-patient verdicts). Discovery is inherently corpus-level; this is the v2 reframe of the audit's 'you don't do discovery' critique.
glossary_terms.name: corpus discovery
